supplements.label: Villanova Writing Supplement (choose one of five, about 250 words): Prompt One
supplements.prompt: As Pope Leo XIV (Villanova Class of 1977) has said, "no one can single-handedly bear the weight of the challenges the world is facing, just as no one is so weak that they cannot play their part." What have you done to play your part in advancing equity and justice in your community?

supplements.label: Villanova Writing Supplement (choose one of five, about 250 words): Prompt Two
supplements.prompt: What is a lesson in life that you have learned that you would want to share with others at Villanova?

supplements.label: Villanova Writing Supplement (choose one of five, about 250 words): Prompt Three
supplements.prompt: "Villanova" means "new home." Why do you want to call Villanova your new home?

supplements.label: Villanova Writing Supplement (choose one of five, about 250 words): Prompt Four
supplements.prompt: Villanova embraces Artificial Intelligence (AI) with a commitment to thoughtful, ethical use rooted in our Augustinian mission and values. How do you see technology helping you to lead, serve, and contribute to the common good?

supplements.label: Villanova Writing Supplement (choose one of five, about 250 words): Prompt Five
supplements.prompt: At Villanova, we often say "each of us strengthens all of us." Please detail a time when someone has borrowed some of your strength in their time of need.
